notes: TaskOrderV2 is H_FIELDS_V1 over exactly 25 top-level fields; OrderOpeningV2 is the 20-field non-monetary projection that replaces generation_params with its H_V1 digest.
The four Amount fields are FRAME_V1(ascii(canonical u64 decimal)), never a bare u64_be, and deadline_policy is a required single-field frame, never a bare enum. The mutations below pin both.
presence_penalty_milli and frequency_penalty_milli are i32_be. They are the reason this fixture needs the int32 typed-field encoding.
generation_params_digest is H_V1 over the canonical JSON projection of section 5.1, which is a different scheme from the nested H_FIELDS_V1 frame the same params take inside task_hash.

order_opening_v2_max_amounts repeats the digest of order_opening_v2_core on purpose: the opening projection excludes all four Amount fields, so moving every amount to u64 max must leave the opening hash untouched while task_hash changes. That pair is the assertion.
Every digest here was produced by a generator whose selftest reproduces the pre-rename published values byte for byte, then re-run against the TrueOpen domains.
